name: Uber Technologies
verdict: PRINT-CONDITIONAL WATCH->STARTER (court 5.5/10, 07-30) - RISK_PREMIUM, no edge claim (the market's most-analyzed question; our read = fairly-priced risk). TWO SCAN-MISSED FACTS (the filings sweep): (1) DELIVERY HERO BCA Jul-16 - EUR41.50/sh cash ~$14B, EUR14B bridge, <2x gross lev, SSW carve-out pre-packaged, close ~late 2027; market absorbed +1.9% = neutral-positive but the buyback story becomes an integration story; Grab 13D/A = likely monetization funding. (2) WAYMO EXCLUSIVITY ENDED Atlanta/Austin Jul-24 (cars stay on Uber thru May-2028) - the disintermediation tell, 6 days before the 52w low = the low is partly FACT-made. AV math: Waymo ~500k rides/wk (~0.2% of Uber volume) compounding ~2.5x/yr from Uber's best US metros -> material share ~2029-30; the -31% prices a 2030-ish inflection w/ partial aggregation failure = a defensible middle.
